alt: An intact bean sits beside a split bean with a small white tip emerging.
A young plant has a branching pale underground system shown through a soil cutaway.
A young plant has an upright green stalk supporting leaves above a branching underground system.
A broad green blade with branching veins is attached to a stalk.
A potted green plant stands beside a bright window.
A watering can pours a small stream onto the soil beside a potted plant.
Young green plants stand in a tray indoors near a bright window.
A leafy plant bends slightly, with curved strokes suggesting a gentle breeze.
Five successive views show a tree increasing in height, trunk thickness, and leafy crown size above a consistent grassy ground line.
A green plant stands in sunshine, with an arrow pointing outward from one leaf.
Four soil cutaways show a bean, an emerging root, an upward shoot, and a small leafy seedling.
A young shoot and white root extend between two thick pale bean halves.

Two pot cutaways compare roots in porous soil with roots in soil filled with water and a pool at the bottom.
A compact green plant stands near a bright window; a tall pale plant with few leaves stands in a dim recess.
An upright plant in moist soil stands beside a drooping plant in dry, cracked soil.
A soil cutaway reveals the roots beneath a plant's upright stem and broad green leaves.
Sunlight shines through attached green leaves, revealing branching veins.
Several different young garden plants grow with gaps between them in a raised wooden bed.
Branching roots pass among mineral grains and soil clumps coated with blue water films.
A child and an adult examine a small potted plant beside a watering can and trowel.
A blue arrow points toward an attached green leaf, and an orange arrow points away from it.
